data.method: One CUA-operated, loopback-only Node-RED/OpenAI test used the declared fictional Maya Chen and Alder House Inn fixture. The recorded sequence was real provider draft, next-day queue, human text edit, one-draft-only approval and seasonal exclusion. The untouched raw screen recording, persisted runtime hashes and safe event chain are bound. The selected screen source removes browser UI, declares the VFR 24fps conform and raw-time ellipses, and the r6 verifier decoded all 29,323 output frames and compared locked audio. The private Tailscale page loaded, returned byte ranges, played and sought in browser, and passed a 375px viewport layout check.
data.scope: Private r6 review candidate only. S13 picture frames [16704,17458) are split into F03 illustrative establish [16704,16752) and real software capture [16752,17458); all 29,323 r5 clock frames and the r3 narration master remain retained.
data.limitations: The fixture is fictional and no message was sent. A passing provider/test/render check establishes only the demonstrated bounded operation. It does not establish recipient consent, customer result, legal compliance, six-property capacity, live delivery, owner creative acceptance or publication. The Tailscale check used a private route and a 375px browser viewport, not a physical phone. Existing r5 presenter review limits and the P08 perceptual lip-sync concern remain open.
